description: Use this whenever you need something you can't do or know yourself: search the live web or news, current weather, places and restaurants near a location, prices, exchange rates, translations, company or product data, documentation, and other live data. Say what you need in plain words; Alonzio picks the best tested provider, runs it and returns its answer with the source. One call, free, no key or account.
